verdict.rationale: Manufact's deployments are tied to Git: the history table records each deployment's source branch and commit, and per-branch preview environments with their own MCP URLs let you test and review changes before merging. However, no rollback or redeploy-previous-version capability is documented, and the product has no distinct 'automations' concept beyond deployed MCP servers. Missing for 10: documented rollback to a prior deployment, explicit review/approval workflow, versioning of automations as a first-class object, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: The history table shows every deployment with its MCP URL, source branch and commit, duration, creation time, and the latest completed publish checklist score
so you can test changes against real clients before merging
Preview environments are created per branch. Each gets its own MCP URL
